result:
The generated C# is exactly correct. Both operations satisfy the spec:

- **`Set`** — when the file doesn't exist, `content` starts empty and (since `found` stays false) the entry `key=value\n` is written as the whole file. When a line matches, it's replaced in place at the same position (`!found && matches`, first match only) with all other lines preserved in order; otherwise the entry is appended as the new last line. Every line is `\n`-terminated. Effect declared `fs:rw` (reads to check/load, writes the result).
- **`Has`** — returns `false` if the file is absent, otherwise `true` iff a line starts with `key=`, distinguishing an empty-value key from an absent one. Declared `fs:r`.
- **`Get`** is unchanged.

The build succeeds cleanly with 0 warnings and 0 errors. The spec is fully satisfied.
